evidence.title: Supa Palette - The ultimate color palette generator for Figma!

name: Supa Palette
summary: Figma plugin that generates accessible color palettes and design-system color scales.
description: A Figma plugin for building color systems: browse 14 integrated color systems and 30,000+ ready-made palettes, refine shades and color spaces, check WCAG 2.1 or APCA contrast, document palettes as guides and save them as Figma variables; palettes export to formats like Figma Tokens, Tailwind or Chakra UI.
contains: 14 integrated color systems incl. Tailwind, Material and Radix
contrast grid and table with WCAG 2.1 or APCA
5 color spaces including LCH and OKLCH
exports to Figma Tokens, Chakra UI, Material UI and Tailwind
palettes saved as Figma variables with light/dark modes
